P.name: Prophet of an Elder God
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Illaoi''' spawns a {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} on the nearest terrain, if no other Tentacle is around it. Tentacles fully spawn after a 2 second delay and are {{tip|untargetable}} in the meantime.
P.description2:
{{as|Tentacles|buzzword2}} are commanded to attack by '''Illaoi's''' {{tip|abilities}}, dealing {{as|{{pplevel|9 to 180}} {{as|(+ 110% AD)}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}} physical damage|physical damage}} to all enemies struck, increased by {{pp|0;10 to 30|0 to 5 for 6|key=%|formula=100% + 10% at rank 1, then 5% per rank|type = [[File:Tentacle Smash.png|20px|link=]] Tentacle Smash's rank}}.
Each enemy individually reduces the slam damage by 50% for every slam they were hit by in the last {{fd|0.66}} seconds, capped at 75% less damage.
P.description3: Each {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} also {{tip|heal|heals}} '''Illaoi''' for {{as|5% of her '''missing''' health}} if it hits at least one enemy {{tip|champion}}.

Q.name: Tentacle Smash
Q.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Illaoi''' slams down a {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} in the target direction.
Q.description3: '''''Illaoi''' {{tip|sight|reveals}} herself during the cast if there is an enemy champion {{tt|nearby|see details}}''.

W.name: Harsh Lesson
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Illaoi''' empowers her next {{tip|basic attack}} within 6 seconds to gain {{sti|range|225 '''bonus''' range}} and cause her to {{tip|dash|leap}} to the target's location if they are beyond her normal basic attack range.
W.description2: The attack deals {{as|'''additional''' physical damage|physical damage}}, with a minimum threshold, and capped at 300 against non-champions, and commands all {{as|Tentacles|buzzword2}} in range to attack the target. The minimum '''additional''' damage can also be applied against {{tip|turrets}}.
W.leveling2:
{{st|Additional Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|3 to 5}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|3.5}}% per 100 AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health|health}}}}
{{st|Minimum Physical Damage|{{ap|20 to 60}}}}
W.description3: ''Harsh Lesson {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Illaoi's''' basic attack timer.''
W.description4: ''Harsh Lesson can be activated during '''Illaoi's''' other abilities.''

E.name: Test of Spirit
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Illaoi''' launches a tendril in the target direction that stops at the first enemy hit, pulling their {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} out in front of '''Illaoi''' over {{fd|0.75}} seconds if they are a {{tip|champion}}. The target is {{tip|tether|tethered}} to the {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} for {{tt|7 seconds|Timer starts when the target is hit}}, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them in addition to granting {{tip|sight}} of the area around them while the tether remains.
E.description2: The {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} spawns with the target's '''current''' {{sti|health|{{as|health}}}}, {{sti|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|magic resist}}}}, and echoes a portion of the {{tt|pre-mitigation damage|Damage calculated before modifiers}} received to the tethered champion.
E.description3: When the {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} is killed or the target leaves tether range, the tether is severed, marking the target as a {{as|Vessel|buzzword3}} for 4 seconds and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 80% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds once the tether returns back to them. Each {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} autonomously attacks the closest {{as|Vessel|buzzword3}} or {{as|Spirit|buzzword}}, prioritizing the latter, once every {{pp|4.5 to 3.5 for 3|1 to 13|formula=4-0.5 every 6 levels, with an up to 0.5-second delay. Cooldown starts upon starting the slam.}} seconds.
E.description4: Enemies made a {{as|Vessel|buzzword3}} continuously spawn a {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} near themselves, when possible. {{as|Tentacles|buzzword2}} can spawn 300 units closer to each other than when spawned by '''Illaoi'''.
E.description5: '''''Illaoi''' is {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} while firing the projectile and while the target's {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} is being pulled. She also {{tip|sight|reveals}} herself while firing the projectile if there is an enemy champion {{tt|nearby|see details}}. {{as|Vessels|buzzword3}} can dispel their mark by scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against '''Illaoi'''. Test of Spirit cannot be cast again until the {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} dies.''

R.name: Leap of Faith
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Illaoi''' gains {{tip|displacement immunity}} and leaps into the air for the cast time. She then slams her idol into the ground, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies. For each enemy champion hit, a {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} is summoned for 8 seconds (up to a maximum of 6 summons).
R.description2: For the duration, ''{{ais|Harsh Lesson|Illaoi}}'' {{sti|cooldown}} is halved, all {{as|Tentacles|buzzword2}} awakened by '''Illaoi''' are {{tip|untargetable}}, will not show their hitboxes, nor go dormant, and will take {{fd|0.5}} seconds to make an attack; however they will then incur a lockout of {{fd|0.5}} seconds before being able to start a new attack.
R.description3: ''This does not affect the {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} attack from {{ai|Tentacle Smash|Illaoi}}.''
